retrievalProfile.description: A low-angle urban portrait featuring a group in a polished convertible against a gradient sunset sky crisscrossed with power lines and sparkling, textured display typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast urban scene captured from a low perspective looking over the hood of a highly reflective car. The background features a warm sunset gradient transitioning to blue, framed by utility poles and wires. Large, sparkling, textured block lettering dominates the upper third of the composition.
coreVisualRelationships: Reflective car hood mirroring the sky and surroundings
Low-angle perspective creating a sense of dominance and scale
Geometric intersection of power lines against a soft sky gradient
Contrast between gritty urban architecture and sparkling luxury typography
coreInvariants: Reflective metallic surface in the foreground

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subjects are framed within the windshield of a car that occupies the bottom half of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The reflective, warm-toned car hood in the immediate foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the reflective hood up to the subjects in the car, then following the power lines to the large display text at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The open sky in the upper half provides space for heavy typography.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm orange and copper (hood and horizon)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white and silver (typography and highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the sky and car reflections; high value contrast in the textured text.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Extra-bold slab serif and block sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Primary text uses a heavy block skeleton with a repeating star-burst or diamond-stud texture fill
Secondary text uses a thick slab serif with rounded corners
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are filled with a grid of four-pointed star glints to simulate jewelry
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy textured sans-serif paired with a solid slab serif for legibility.

avoid: Serifs on the primary display text

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary heavy block skeleton for the textured fill.
Matches the sturdy slab serif feel of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A low-angle photo looking over the polished, reflective copper-colored hood of a convertible car. Inside the car, a group of people are visible through the windshield. The background is an urban street at sunset with a gradient sky from orange to blue, featuring prominent black power lines crossing the frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, stacked block text in the upper left with a silver diamond-stud texture. Add a secondary two-line slab-serif title in solid white to the right of the main text.

verificationChecks: Is the camera angle low enough to emphasize the car hood?
Does the sky have a clear orange-to-blue gradient?
Are the power lines visible against the sky?
Does the main text have a sparkling, textured appearance?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subjects
Specific brand logos or advisory stickers
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text texture looks like individual glints rather than a flat pattern.
Check that the power lines do not obscure the faces of the subjects.
Verify the low-angle perspective creates a sense of depth.
Confirm the color palette remains warm and vibrant.
recipe.reuseFormula: Low-angle urban automotive portrait + sunset sky gradient + power line geometry + textured heavy-weight display typography.
